| # SID - ReadDTCInformation (0x19) {#sid---readdtcinformation-0x19-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                       |                                                                                                                                                               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This topic explains the service related to Stored data transmission functional unit - ReadDTCInformation.

 

Definition and Short description as per ISO 14229-1:

 

  -------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Service              Description
  ReadDTCInformation   Allows the client to request diagnostic information from the server (including DTCs, captured data, etc.).
  -------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ReadDTCInformation service is used by the diagnostic tool (client) to retrieve different status data of DTCs.

## Key status data retrieved from this service: {#key-status-data-retrieved-from-this-service .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

  -------------------------------------------------------- ------------------ ------------------------------------
  Key Status Data                                          UDS Sub-function   Sub-function Name
  DTC Status (Active / Deactive / Previously Active DTC)   0x02               reportDTCByStatusMask
  Freeze frame - Operating Hours                           0x04               reportDTCSnapshotRecordByDTCNumber
  Freeze frame - Occurrence Counter                        0x06               reportDTCExtDataRecordByDTCNumber
  Environment Data                                         0x04               reportDTCSnapshotRecordByDTCNumber
  -------------------------------------------------------- ------------------ ------------------------------------
